audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Jayce, Skill, Shen, Shen, Jayce, Shen, Shen — disagreeing with the packet and with the mirror record on jayce__shen, and with the page's own prose ('Accept that Levels 2 and 3 are his').
audit.why: Level 1 is neutral, 2-3 are his poke window, 4-5 are Shen's first foothold, 6 is Stand United, and the first-item window is his cannon poke.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Shen, Shen, Jayce, Shen in both layers as one atomic paired group.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why told you to force fights the moment Iceborn Gauntlet completes, but that row is Jayce's window.
audit.why: His cannon-form poke outranges a first-item Shen; the fight has to be bought with a spent Shock Blast, not an item timing.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now keys the first-item window to the 16s after Shock Blast is spent. The four spikes themselves (2-3, 4-5, 6, 1st item) are correct and kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'mid' claimed Spirit's Refuge blocks his follow-up autos AND Thundering Blow. It blocks attacks only — Thundering Blow and Shock Blast pass straight through it. phases[1].why implied the same blanket block. dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d carried text unrelated to their titles, and no real cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Believing the W stops Thundering Blow gets you knocked out of your own taunt at the exact moment you commit — the single most costly misread in this lane.
audit.corrected: mid now states the attacks-only limit and that Thundering Blow still displaces you; phases[1].why and dosFull[0].d carry Shock Blast's 16s rank-1 cooldown; dontsFull[0].d states that firing Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate increases its speed, range and damage; dontsFull[1].d states the Thundering Blow trade reset; dosFull[2].d gives Shadow Dash's 600 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flagged "Shock Blast's" and "Use Stand United".
audit.why: Both false positives — a possessive apostrophe and a leading verb inflate the edit distance; both names match the kit exactly.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are your first real foothold — his Shock Blast cooldown is the entire game clock. When you see him throw it and miss or use it to clear a minion wave, that is your commit window: E-taunt him, activate W so your spirit blade zone blocks his follow-up autos and Thundering Blow, and pull the blade back through him with Q for the full magic-damage shred. He has no reliable escape from a full taunt if you land it; the W bubble means his melee hammer autos deal almost nothing back. Keep the wave near your side of the lane so he must walk up to last-hit and sit inside your engage range. At Level 6 Jayce's R gives him instant stance-swap flexibility that raises his ceiling, but Stand United means every teamfight, dive, and bot-lane skirmish can become a Shen play — your real power is leaving this lane entirely. Track Shock Blast, deny his cannon-form poke, and be ready to R the moment a teammate is in a killable position.
